title: Codex add project bootstrap checklist
summary: Use Codex to add a manifest-driven project bootstrap checklist artifact for first app-host onboarding, with focused docs and tests, without performing any live bootstrap action.

actions.prompt: Add a small manifest-driven bootstrap checklist path for Cortex project manifests. Prefer extending existing manifest tooling so validated project manifests can render a deterministic planning-only bootstrap checklist artifact or stdout for a first single-VM project runtime host. Cover target host, required runtime prerequisites, services requested, secret references, route dependencies, and explicit human approval checkpoints. Keep scope tight: do not modify bootstrap/compose/edge/*, do not perform any live bootstrap action, do not change .codex/config.toml, and keep the output as planning/documentation only. Add focused docs/tests and run targeted validation/tests afterward.
